v_new_exp timestamptz;\r\n  v_new_status text;\r\nbegin\r\n  select (coalesce(is_admin, false) = true or coalesce(email, '') = 'ai.interiorid@gmail.com') into v_is_adm\r\n  from public.profiles where id = v_caller_id;\r\n\r\n  if not coalesce(v_is_adm, false) then\r\n    if exists (select 1 from auth.users where id = v_caller_id and email = 'ai.interiorid@gmail.com') then\r\n      v_is_adm := p_action = 'extend' then\r\n    update public.profiles\r\n    set \r\n      expires_at = greatest(now(), coalesce(expires_at, now())) + (p_days || ' days')::interval,\r\n      subscription_status = 'active',\r\n      updated_at = now()\r\n    where id = p_target_user_id\r\n    returning expires_at, subscription_status into v_new_exp, v_new_status;\r\n\r\n  elsif p_action = 'expire' or p_action = record;\r\n  v_tx record;\r\nbegin\r\n  select * into v_link from public.telegram_links where chat_id = p_chat_id and is_active = true limit 1;\r\n  if not found then\r\n    return json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Akun belum terhubung.');\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- Cari dompet yang cocok\r\n  if p_wallet_name is not null and trim(p_wallet_name) <> '' then\r\n    select * into v_wallet from public.wallets \r\n    where owner_id = v_link.owner_id and lower(name) like '%' || lower(trim(p_wallet_name)) || '%' and is_active = true \r\n    limit 1;\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  if v_wallet.id is null then\r\n    select * into v_wallet from public.wallets \r\n    where owner_id = v_link.owner_id and is_active = true \r\n    order by created_at asc limit 1;\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- Jika belum ada dompet, buatkan dompet Kas Tunai otomatis\r\n  if v_wallet.id is null then\r\n    insert into public.wallets (owner_id, name, kind, is_active)\r\n    values (v_link.owner_id, 'Tunai', 'cash', true)\r\n    returning * into v_wallet;\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- Insert transaksi\r\n  insert into public.transactions (owner_id, occurred_at, kind, amount, description, wallet_id, source)\r\n  values (v_link.owner_id, now(), p_kind, p_amount, p_description, v_wallet.id, 'telegram')\r\n  returning * into v_tx;\r\n\r\n  return json_build_object(\r\n    'success', true,\r\n    'tx_id', v_tx.id,\r\n    'wallet_name', v_wallet.name,\r\n    'amount', v_tx.amount,\r\n    'kind', v_tx.kind,\r\n    'description', v_tx.description\r\n  );\r\nend;\r\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"handle_new_user_setup","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user_setup()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\nAS $function$\r\nbegin\r\n  -- 1. Buat profil dengan masa aktif percobaan 14 hari (atau diset tahunan saat aktif)\r\n  insert into public.profiles (id, email, subscription_status, plan, expires_at, created_at)\r\n  values (\r\n    new.id,\r\n    new.email,\r\n    'trial',\r\n    'Tahunan',\r\n    (now() + interval '14 days'),\r\n    now()\r\n  ) on conflict (id) do nothing;\r\n\r\n  -- 2. Buat dompet awal default\r\n  insert into public.wallets (owner_id, name, kind)\r\n  values \r\n    (new.id, 'Tunai / Cash', 'cash'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Rekening Bank', 'bank')\r\n  on conflict do nothing;\r\n\r\n  -- 3. Buat kategori dasar pengeluaran & pemasukan\r\n  insert into public.categories (owner_id, name, type, icon)\r\n  values\r\n    (new.id, 'Makanan & Minuman', 'expense', '🍔'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Transportasi & Bensin', 'expense', '⛽'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Belanja Kebutuhan', 'expense', '🛒'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Tagihan & Listrik/Air', 'expense', '⚡'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Gaji / Upah', 'income', '💼'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Hasil Usaha / Penjualan', 'income', '🏪'),\r\n    (new.id, 'Bonus & Lain-lain', 'income', '🎁')\r\n  on conflict do nothing;\r\n\r\n  return new;\r\nend;\r\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"link_telegram_by_code","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.link_telegram_by_code(p_link_code text, p_chat_id text, p_username text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_first_name text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS json\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\nAS $function$\r\ndeclare\r\n  v_profile record;\r\n  v_clean_code text;\r\nbegin\r\n  v_clean_code := upper(trim(p_link_code));\r\n  if v_clean_code = '' or v_clean_code is null then\r\n    return json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Kode tautan tidak valid.');\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- 1. Cari profil yang memiliki kode ini\r\n  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where telegram_link_code = v_clean_code limit 1;\r\n  \r\n  -- 2. Jika kode belum tersimpan karena browser belum sync, pasangkan ke akun pengguna terbaru\r\n  if not found then\r\n    select * into v_profile from public.profiles order by created_at desc limit 1;\r\n    if found then\r\n      update public.profiles set telegram_link_code = v_clean_code where id = v_profile.id;\r\n    else\r\n      -- Jika belum ada di public.profiles, cek auth.users\r\n      insert into public.profiles (id, email, telegram_link_code, subscription_status, plan)\r\n      select id, email, v_clean_code, 'trial', 'Tahunan' from auth.users order by created_at desc limit 1\r\n      on conflict (id) do update set telegram_link_code = v_clean_code\r\n      returning * into v_profile;\r\n    end if;\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  if v_profile.id is null then\r\n    return json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Akun pengguna belum terdaftar di database.');\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- 3. Hubungkan chat_id nomor HP ini ke akun web (Multi-Device per Akun)\r\n  insert into public.telegram_links (owner_id, chat_id, username, first_name, is_active, linked_at)\r\n  values (v_profile.id, p_chat_id, p_username, p_first_name, true, now())\r\n  on conflict (chat_id) do update set\r\n    owner_id = excluded.owner_id,\r\n    username = excluded.username,\r\n    first_name = excluded.first_name,\r\n    is_active = true,\r\n    linked_at = now();\r\n\r\n  return json_build_object('success', true, 'email', v_profile.email, 'owner_id', v_profile.id, 'user_id', v_profile.id);\r\nend;\r\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"prevent_cross_owner_payment","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_cross_owner_payment()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nbegin\n if not exists (select 1 from public.obligations o where o.id = new.obligation_id and o.owner_id = (select auth.uid())) then\n  raise exception 'Obligation not owned by current user';\n end if;\n if not exists (select 1 from public.wallets w where w.id = new.wallet_id and w.owner_id = (select auth.uid())) then\n  raise exception 'Wallet not owned by current user';\n end if;\n return new;\nend; $function$\n"},{"proname":"record_obligation_payment","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_obligation_payment(p_obligation_id uuid, p_wallet_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_note text DEFAULT ''::text)\n RETURNS json\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\nAS $function$\r\ndeclare\r\n  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();\r\n  v_ob record;\r\n  v_total_paid numeric;\r\n  v_new_total numeric;\r\n  v_new_status text;\r\n  v_tx_kind text;\r\n  v_payment_id uuid;\r\nbegin\r\n  if v_user_id is null then\r\n    raise exception 'Unauthorized';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  if p_amount <= 0 then\r\n    raise exception 'Nominal pembayaran harus lebih besar dari 0';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  select * into v_ob from public.obligations where id = p_obligation_id and owner_id = v_user_id;\r\n  if not found then\r\n    raise exception 'Data utang/piutang tidak ditemukan';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) into v_total_paid from public.obligation_payments where obligation_id = p_obligation_id;\r\n  v_new_total := v_total_paid + p_amount;\r\n\r\n  if v_new_total > v_ob.principal then\r\n    raise exception 'Nominal melebihi sisa tagihan (Maksimal: %)', (v_ob.principal - v_total_paid);\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  if v_new_total >= v_ob.principal then\r\n    v_new_status := 'paid';\r\n  else\r\n    v_new_status := 'partial';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- Tentukan jenis mutasi transaksi kas\r\n  if v_ob.type = 'debt' then\r\n    v_tx_kind := 'debt_payment'; -- Mengurangi saldo dompet\r\n  else\r\n    v_tx_kind := 'receivable_payment'; -- Menambah saldo dompet\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  -- 1. Catat ke tabel obligation_payments\r\n  insert into public.obligation_payments (owner_id, obligation_id, wallet_id, amount, note, paid_at)\r\n  values (v_user_id, p_obligation_id, p_wallet_id, p_amount, coalesce(p_note, ''), now())\r\n  returning id into v_payment_id;\r\n\r\n  -- 2. Update status obligation\r\n  update public.obligations set status = v_new_status where id = p_obligation_id;\r\n\r\n  -- 3. Catat mutasi otomatis ke transactions\r\n  insert into public.transactions (\r\n    owner_id, occurred_at, kind, amount, description, wallet_id, source\r\n  ) values (\r\n    v_user_id,\r\n    now(),\r\n    v_tx_kind,\r\n    p_amount,\r\n    case when v_ob.type = 'debt' then 'Bayar utang ke ' || v_ob.contact_name else 'Terima piutang dari ' || v_ob.contact_name end || case when coalesce(p_note,'') <> '' then ' (' || p_note || ')' else '' end,\r\n    p_wallet_id,\r\n    'web'\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  return json_build_object('success', true, 'payment_id', v_payment_id, 'status', v_new_status);\r\nend;\r\n$function$\n"}]}}]
